overall: The AG found the Southbridge Town Council violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a March 30 notice topic, "review/discuss the recommendations of the Charter Review Committee and take any action," that was too vague to cover the Charter changes it discussed and referred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the March 30 notice topic on Charter Review Committee recommendations was too vague to tell the public the Council would take up specific Charter changes.
allegations.key_passage: In light of the Council’s discussion and vote, we find that the language of the March 30 notice, “review/discuss the recommendations of the Charter Review Committee and take any action” was insufficiently specific.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
